questions.text: O formulário pede “Awareness and understanding of how Equality, Diversity and Inclusion, Dignity & Respect, and Human Rights will apply to this role.”: o que escreveria?
questions.english: The form asks for "Awareness and understanding of how Equality, Diversity and Inclusion, Dignity & Respect, and Human Rights will apply to this role.": what would you write?
questions.why: The app asks this itself: the form wants it in your own words, and none of your confirmed facts says it in the first person.

answer.text: I have worked for three years in a care home in Leeds, starting in October 2023.
I see dignity as knocking before entering, explaining personal care and always closing curtains.
I respect each person's culture and religion and I ask what they want to eat, how they want to be treated and if they prefer a female carer.
One night I saw a bruise on a resident's arm.
I recorded it and told the nurse on duty immediately, and she made the safeguarding referral.
In the dementia unit we as the whole team moved dinner earlier because residents were agitated at end of day.
I have moving and handling training and I use the hoist, and we always work in a pair.
I have medication training and I do the morning medication round for 18 residents.
Before the shift I read each resident's care plan and do what is in it.
At the end of the shift I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet.
I made cards with photos of food so each person can point to what they want to eat.
I did three years of nights and also weekends.

letter.text: Dear North Yorkshire Council hiring team,
I am applying for the Care and Support Worker role at North Yorkshire Council.
I have worked for 3 years in a care home in Leeds, having started in October 2023.
Before each shift I read each resident's care plan and do what is in it.
I have moving and handling training and I use the hoist.
I do the morning medication round for 18 residents.
At the end of the shift I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet.
I did 3 years of nights and also weekends.
I made cards with photos of food so each person can point to what they want to eat.
One night I saw a bruise on a resident's arm.
I recorded it and told the nurse on duty immediately.
Thank you for considering my application.
Yours sincerely, Ana
